# Phaminh Cinematography

> Luxury wedding videographer in Vacaville, California, serving Napa Valley, Sonoma, the San Francisco Bay Area and Sacramento. Cinematic, story-driven wedding films and photography by Minh Pham, with a few weddings each year in Arkansas. Packages from $2,700; elopement films from $2,500. One wedding per day, full attention on every couple.

Phaminh Cinematography is owned and operated by Minh Pham, a wedding videographer based in Vacaville, California, in Solano County between Napa Valley and Sacramento on Interstate 80. Napa Valley, Sonoma and the San Francisco Bay Area are the primary markets, with no travel fees anywhere in Solano, Napa, Yolo or Sacramento counties. Minh has deep roots in Arkansas and still films a few weddings there each year. The style is documentary at heart and cinematic in craft: real vows, real toasts, and real moments edited into films couples rewatch for decades. Rated 5.0 stars on The Knot and WeddingWire.

## Service Areas

### Northern California (primary market)

- [Vacaville & Suisun Valley wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/vacaville-suisun-valley): Minh's home turf, with Suisun Valley Inn, Vezér Family Vineyard (The Blue Victorian, Mankas Gardens), Bally Keal Estate and Il Fiorello; no travel fees anywhere in Solano County
- [Napa Valley wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/napa-valley): Auberge du Soleil, Carneros Resort, Stanly Ranch, Solage, historic wineries; 30-40 minutes from Minh's home base
- [Sacramento wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/sacramento): Vizcaya, Scribner Bend Vineyards, Park Winters, Field & Pond; about 35 minutes away, no travel fee
- [Sonoma & Healdsburg wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/sonoma-healdsburg): Montage Healdsburg, Chateau St. Jean, Sonoma wine country
- [San Francisco wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/san-francisco): City Hall elopements, the Presidio, luxury hotel weddings
- [Silicon Valley & Peninsula wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/silicon-valley): Palo Alto, Woodside, Saratoga, Los Gatos, San Jose
- [Carmel, Monterey & Big Sur wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/carmel-big-sur): coastal weddings and cliff elopements
- [Half Moon Bay wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/half-moon-bay): The Ritz-Carlton and coastside venues
- [Marin County wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/marin-county): Cavallo Point, Sausalito, Muir Woods elopements
- [Lake Tahoe wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/lake-tahoe): Edgewood, The Ritz-Carlton, lakefront ceremonies

### Arkansas (secondary market)

- [Northwest Arkansas wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/northwest-arkansas): Fayetteville, Bentonville, Rogers, Springdale
- [Eureka Springs wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/eureka-springs): Thorncrown Chapel, the 1886 Crescent Hotel
- [Hot Springs wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/hot-springs): Anthony Chapel at Garvan Woodland Gardens
- [Little Rock wedding videographer](https://www.phaminh.com/wedding-videographer/little-rock): Central Arkansas, including Little Rock, Conway and Benton

## Common Questions

- Q: Where is Phaminh Cinematography based? A: Vacaville, California, in Solano County between Napa Valley and Sacramento on Interstate 80.
- Q: How much does a wedding film cost? A: Wedding videography packages start at $2,700; elopement films start at $2,500. Most couples invest $2,700-$8,000.
- Q: Are there travel fees? A: No travel fees anywhere in Solano, Napa, Yolo, or Sacramento counties. Bay Area, Tahoe, and Arkansas travel is quoted per wedding and is usually modest.
- Q: How far in advance should couples book? A: Minh limits bookings to 20-25 weddings a year and often books 1-2 years ahead; popular fall and late-spring Saturdays go first.
- Q: How long until the film is delivered? A: Per contract, wedding and elopement films are delivered within 6-8 weeks, with sneak peeks shared along the way.
- Q: Does Minh film outside California? A: Yes. A few weddings each year in Northwest Arkansas, Hot Springs and Little Rock, plus destination weddings by arrangement.
